page.overview:
Who is Menoitios?

The Argonaut Menoitios is the name of three characters in Greek Mythology. While he is listed among the crew of the Argo. His part on the quest is not specified. Menoitios did become the father of Patroklus and Myrto (by either Sthenele, Periopis or Polymele)
